name: subagents-plus
description: See your subagents: a /subagents pane with an expandable tree of every subagent (live activity, tokens, transcripts) and a timeline, live cards on Agent rows, and a band above the prompt

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on the first subagent
autoOpen.description: Opens the Agents pane once per session when the first subagent spawns, only where the surface docks panes beside the transcript

inlineCards.title: Live cards on Agent rows
inlineCards.description: Draw a live card on each Agent tool row: on the desktop only, everywhere, or nowhere

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: A compact live strip above the prompt while subagents run

streamTap.title: Model-time tap
streamTap.description: Time each model request (turn.step) for subagents, for every loop, or not at all; off approximates model time from gaps between tool calls

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: Pulse live agents and animate the small pictures where the surface draws them

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics tool
diagnostics.description: Register a status tool the model can call to read what the mod sees and draws (development aid)
